name: enable-banking-mcp
description: Personal MCP server for bank data via Enable Banking PSD2 AIS API

AUTH_SECRET.description: A password you choose. Used to log in to the setup page and to approve MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor). Use a long random value and save it in your password manager.

ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: A second long random value, different from AUTH_SECRET. Encrypts your Enable Banking private key in KV. Save it in your password manager.

BANKING_KV.description: Stores your bank connection and encrypted Enable Banking key. Give it a unique name, e.g. `enable-banking-mcp-data`.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores logins from Claude/ChatGPT. Give it a different name, e.g. `enable-banking-mcp-oauth`.
